research_rationale:
EO 11409 (signed 1968-04-29; 33 FR 6601) was read in full in the held Federal Register text layer. Acting under section 5317 of title 5, U.S. Code, it amends Executive Order No. 11248 of October 10, 1965, as amended. Section 1 (level IV): (a) deletes item (3), Special Assistant to the Secretary (Food-For-Peace Program), State Department, and inserts item (3), Administrator, Social and Rehabilitation Service, HEW; (b) deletes item (4), Executive Secretary of the President's Commission on Law Enforcement and Administration of Justice, and inserts item (4), Administrator, National Institutes of Health, HEW; (c) adds item (8), Administrator, Health Services and Mental Health Administration, HEW, and item (9), Executive Director, Cabinet Committee on Price Stability. Section 2 (level V) deletes item (15), Administrator, Social and Rehabilitation Service, and inserts item (15), Deputy Administrator, Health Services and Mental Health Administration. The commands that remove the earlier items (3), (4) and (15) were performed when the order took effect; the clauses below are the placements the order made, one per item, with the lead and introductions folded in. EO 11468 (1969-05-10) replaced item (9) with a different office, which under the strike-and-insert ruling is an amendment (substance changed) and the clause continues, amended; EO 11581, EO 11604 and EO 11634 only renumbered items. EO 11708 (signed 1973-03-23) section 3 revoked EO 11248 as amended except the eight level V positions enumerated in its section 2, which do not include the Deputy Administrator of the Health Services and Mental Health Administration; so all five clauses first ended on 1973-03-23 by express revocation of the parent order as amended, and the whole-order end is that date. Section 1 of EO 11708 places the Administrators of the Social and Rehabilitation Service, the National Institutes of Health and the Health Services and Mental Health Administration in level IV as new placements under its own text. I found no held instrument that ends any item earlier. Original not an authenticated transcription: the held text is the OCR text layer of the official Federal Register issue; quotations avoid its recognition errors.
